info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for modifications to existing deposit lending agreements based on specific parameters. Users can update terms and conditions related to term deposit frameworks, enabling tailored financial solutions. Typical consumers include banking professionals and financial institutions looking to adjust loan offers or manage customer agreements efficiently. This operation ensures that deposit products remain competitive and aligned with market needs.

patch.summary: Update a term deposit framework agreement.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific term deposit framework agreement identified by its resource identifier. Ensure all required fields are included in the request to successfully apply the changes.
